장비는 대장간에서 산다. 강해지는 수단이 아니라 살아남기 위한 최소한이다: Gear is bought at the Smithy. It won't make you strong — it's the bare minimum to stay alive.
그 신을 섬기지 않아 꺼져 있다: inactive: you don't serve that god
그 신을 섬기지 않아 빛을 잃었다: dimmed: you don't serve that god
이번 삶에서 다시 들어야 진엔딩이 열린다: must be heard again in this life to unlock the True ending
이번 삶은 끝났다. (엔딩으로 끝났다면 그 이야기도 묘지에 남는다. 진실: This life is over. (If it ended in an ending, that story stays in the Graveyard too. Pieces of Truth carry over to the next life, and once you see the True ending, every god can be chosen from then on.) Depending on how you died, an Old God's faith is unlocked (selectable in your next life), and the Bestiary and unlocked faiths carry over. Read the cause of death on the tombstone and change how you prepare next time.
미궁은 열여섯·열일곱 살만 받아들인다 — 1~12월은 16세, 13~24: The Labyrinth only takes sixteen- and seventeen-year-olds — months 1–12 you are 16, months 13–24 you are 17. On the morning of month 25 you turn eighteen: the Labyrinth closes its doors and the Lord's Pursuers come. There is no escape, and defeat means execution. Before then you must reach the Scepter and see an ending (clearing Sector 6 means nothing unless you take the Scepter or leave it behind). The age display in the header turns red when 6 months remain.
옛 신을 오래 섬기면 성당이 눈치챈다. 신앙을 포기하면 신앙심이 사라지고: Serve an Old God for long and the Cathedral takes notice. Renounce your faith and your Piety vanishes — that's the end of it. Refuse and you become Wanted: town facilities (shops, training, Inn, Temple) are closed to you, you live on the outskirts, and Inquisitors follow you into the Labyrinth.
마을 시설을 쓸 수 없고 마석은 밀수꾼에게 반값에 판다. 고기·물약은 외: You can't use town facilities, and you sell mana stones to smugglers at half price. Meat and potions cost double at the Black Market on the outskirts. Training is blocked too, but on an Expedition to the outskirts you may find a wandering trainer (20% at first, 50% once you've met one) — you can only train in the week you meet them, so you must find them again each time. You pay no tax. Each time you move rooms in the Labyrinth, an Inquisitor may appear (defeat one for Piety +10). Turn yourself in at the Cathedral to abandon your faith and go free.
몬스터가 아주 드물게 남기는 힘의 조각. 흡수하면 능력치가 오르고, 몬스: A fragment of power that monsters very rarely leave behind. Absorbing it raises your stats, and some monsters grant an ability. You won't know what an unfamiliar Shard gives until you absorb it. You gain a slot every 3 levels, and the Temple can erase one for 1000G. Shards you don't absorb scatter.
4·7·10레벨로 가는 훈련은 보스가 남긴 재료(4레벨: 거대 쥐의 마석: Training toward levels 4, 7 and 10 requires a material left by a boss (level 4: Giant Rat's mana stone heart; level 7: General's rusted insignia). You gain the specialty of the branch you pick and grow much stronger, and can use that branch's active one extra time per battle. Check the level table on the training screen and settle on your main branch.
여기서 삶의 끝을 고른다. 셉터를 들면 영주에게 바치는 일반 엔딩(이단은: Here you choose how your life ends. Take the Scepter for the ordinary ending, offering it to the Lord (heretics can't enter the Lord's castle). Leave the Scepter for the battle at the Lord's castle — a shot at the True ending (requires 5 Pieces of Truth + the Lord's Edict from this life + serving an Old God). Hold off, and only the Sector 6 clear is recognized and your life goes on (next time you fight the Avatar again). Descend below the altar for the endless Labyrinth.
타락한 신전과 차원문의 성소: The fallen temple and the Rift Gate Shrine
6섹터, 마지막이다. 흰빛은 옛 신의 기척을 깎는다(정화) — 신앙심이: Sector 6, the last. White light wears away the presence of the Old Gods (Purification) — if your Piety drops below a ★ threshold, that power goes dark for this Labyrinth run. Old God incense or an inverted holy symbol can block it. In rooms of holy light, faith powers are halved. Linger too long on floors 1–2 and the Eye of Judgment descends. The Inquisitor in the floor 2 confessional holds the Lord's Edict needed for the True ending. Floor 3 is a single path — the altar of the Old Gods (your god's relic, answers from the gods you've unlocked) → three sealed doors → the Avatar. When the Avatar falls, it rises once more and devours your powers. If you might lose, turn on fleeing in Battle tactics.
5섹터는 균열이 12시간마다 숨을 쉰다. 들숨 때는 어둡고(앞방 엿보기·: In Sector 5 the rift breathes every 12 hours. On the inhale it grows dark (peeking ahead and cliff-path checks −2) and hungry wraiths crawl out. Cliff paths are a visible danger — cross carefully (takes more time), fix a rope, or just cross. A fall drops you to the floor below, but you miss that floor. Get grabbed or pushed in a fight on a cliff and you fall. Hungry things steal your Satiety — bring plenty of meat. Offer meat at the altar of plenty and it shows the face of plenty or of famine.
4섹터는 12시간마다 바람과 고임이 바뀐다. 고임 때는 1·2층이 끓어: In Sector 4, draft and stillness alternate every 12 hours. During the stillness floors 1–2 boil: fire creatures turn fierce and gas explosions grow larger. During the draft, the floor 3 ice zone grows colder. Burns come all at once, and fighting on with a severe injury leads to a lost limb (burn salve, underground pools). When cold builds to 4, frostbite sets into your hands and feet (light a fire and camp). Traps abound — gas clears if you wait, and mine carts can be sent at enemies by throwing the switch.
3섹터는 12시간마다 물이 차고 빠진다. 밀물 때 물에 잠긴 방은 지나기: In Sector 3 the water rises and falls every 12 hours. At high tide, flooded rooms are slow to cross and water beasts grow fierce; at low tide you can pick up offerings (mana stones) from the floor. The deep water on floor 3 must be swum (dangerous in heavy armor). Acid slime corrodes gear (it won't break — whetstone or Smithy repairs), poison drains HP each time you move rooms, and paralysis numbs your limbs (antidote herb; wears off when you leave the Labyrinth).
실력에 비해 얕은 층(이 층 아래로 내려가도 될 만한 레벨)에 오래 머물: Linger too long on a floor too shallow for your strength (one where your level says you could go deeper) and the Labyrinth comes to clear it. Two warnings come (on the second, the exit is revealed on the map), and about a day later the Sweeper appears, closing in one room each time you move — two rooms if you camp. It is far stronger than that sector's boss — escape by taking the stairs down or leaving the Labyrinth. They say defeating it brings a great reward.
The end of the sector. Reaching the Rift Gate clears that sector (your Rank goes up). Enter to move on to the next sector, doubling your remaining time. Turning back still counts as a clear.
옛 신의 제단. 섬기는 신에게 기도하면 신앙심이 오른다. 신앙심이 30·: An altar of the Old Gods. Pray to the god you serve to raise your Piety. When Piety passes 30, 60 and 90, the ★1–★3 powers open. You can convert to another unlocked god, but the god you abandon curses you for a month. The deeper your faith, the likelier the Inquisition.
공포·분노·혼란·절망은 걸려도 처음엔 모른다. 방을 옮길 때 감각·지능으: Fear, rage, confusion and despair go unnoticed at first. They surface when you notice them with PER or INT while moving between rooms. When two overlap, combined symptoms break out — fits, panic, collapse. They may subside when you leave the Labyrinth, and resting at the Inn calms them all.
부위마다 경상 → 중상 → 결손으로 나빠진다. 머리·몸통이 결손되면 즉사: Each body part worsens from light → severe → lost. A lost head or torso means instant death; a lost hand or foot can be replaced by a Temple regeneration rite or a prosthesis from the Smithy. Neither light nor severe injuries heal on their own — rest at the Inn or use bandages. Rat fever is cured with a herbal decoction or at the Inn.
해체하거나(민첩 판정), 조심해서 지나가거나(민첩으로 회피), 왔던 길로: You can disarm it (DEX check), pass carefully (dodge with DEX), or retreat the way you came. Fail to disarm or dodge and the trap goes off. From floor 2 on, collapsing floors are mixed in — fall through and you tumble to the floor below. Hidden goblins sometimes strike while you're caught in a trap.
남은 시간(일주일), 포만감, 피로도를 지켜보며 방을 고른다. 전투는 자: Pick rooms while watching your remaining time (one week), Satiety and Fatigue. Combat is automatic; potion and flee tactics are changed in settings. When hungry, you eat meat from your pack on your own (can be turned off in settings). Mana stones you carry only become money once you leave the Labyrinth. When time runs out you are dragged out; a recall scroll gets you out at once. A PER check lets you peek into the room ahead.
1~3주는 마을에서 한 주에 한 가지(훈련·탐문·외부 탐험·여관)를 하고: In weeks 1–3 you do one thing per week in town (Training, Ask around, Expedition, Inn), and in week 4 you enter the Labyrinth. Fail to pay tax at month's end and you are executed. HP and injuries don't recover on their own — you must pay to rest at the Inn. Market prices and Inn fees rise every month. You can't train in the first month — the trainer only takes you once you come back alive from the Labyrinth. Shopping takes no time.
